title: Shift records (Carly) and My past shifts (cleaners)
question: Past shifts, this fortnight first, then 'Show earlier' back to 6 months. Tapping a shift opens the sheet you just picked. Cleaners get the same screen with their own shifts only. Pick one, or steer.

options.label: A Day list with photo strips
options.lineage: Same day labels and filter chips as Carly's dashboard
options.thesis: One list, newest day first. Each row: who, times, worked, a strip of small photos, amber 'No photos' or flag tags.
options.viewport: Back · Shift records · chips All/Josh/Kyle… · Wed 28 Oct: Gladys · Morning with 2 photos · Tue 27 Oct: Kyle · No photos · Over time.
options.risk: Long list over months; the person chips and 'Show earlier' keep it short.

options.label: B Grouped by person
options.lineage: A per-person summary, like a team report
options.thesis: A section per cleaner with their fortnight hours, each shift one line with its photo count.
options.viewport: Josh · 2 shifts · 5h 51m: Wed 28 Oct Night 8 photos…; Kyle · No photos (amber)…
options.risk: Weak for 'what happened yesterday?', and no photos are visible until you tap.

options.label: C Photo cards
options.thesis: Each shift a card with a mosaic of its first photos above the times.
options.viewport: Chips · Josh card with mosaic · Kyle card 'No photos' · Angel card.
options.risk: Only about three shifts per screen, and it is the card stack the design system avoids.
